external_primary_evidence.supports: novel interactive environments jointly exercise exploration, modeling, goal-setting, planning/execution and feedback-driven course correction
test-taker must not know the test; private/secure tasks reduce false-positive adaptation/generalization claims
first-run evaluation and action counts preserve the cost of initial exploration/mechanics learning
reproducible interactive environments with functional correctness measure end-to-end task completion
stateful agent evaluation can judge terminal environment/database state and repeated-run reliability

external_primary_evidence.source: Chollet, On the Measure of Intelligence, arXiv:1911.01547
external_primary_evidence.supports: task skill is confounded by priors/experience; generalization difficulty and prior exposure must be controlled

preserve: receipt/reconciliation identities and fail-closed component-scope authority
observed_current_wp807.critical_gap: Current evaluate_agentic_core can support four separately measured capability records without proving that one unchanged agent/build/policy traversed one previously unseen episode, causally coupled the capabilities, recovered from unexpected feedback and completed that episode. holdout_set_id string equality is not consumed-fixture identity or trajectory identity.
additional_contract_gaps: success_count is aggregated but not directly required by the WP807 verdict
submitted score_ppm values are not recomputed at the WP807 boundary from bound raw run results
unique receipt hashes establish distinct objects, not experimental independence
no shared agent-build/policy/runtime identity spans the four capability records
no shared episode/run-package/causal-trajectory identity spans the four capability records
no first-contact/prior-exposure/reset provenance is represented at the aggregate boundary

architecture_delta.diagnostic_layer: Keep the existing four capability measurements as local falsifiers. Do not replace them with one opaque leaderboard scalar.
minimum_integrated_bindings: runtime/config identity or explicit repository-evaluator identity
recovery event identity after unexpected transition
internal-compute receipt identity delegated to the already-existing WP807 internal-compute-cost E2 delta
architecture_delta.causal_requirement: The SAME bound episode must contain public-observation-driven exploration, at least one falsifiable prediction/model update, goal/win-condition inference without evaluator-label access, planning/execution, feedback-driven correction/recovery and terminal completion evidence. Separate WP802-WP805 runs may diagnose capabilities but cannot substitute for this integrated trajectory.
architecture_delta.heldout_requirement: Public development and sealed evaluation fixtures must be separated at a family/mechanism level sufficient to make memorized public trajectories non-diagnostic. Random-seed-only separation is not automatically sufficient.
architecture_delta.score_requirement: Require typed/binary completion and preserve raw action/recovery/compute measures. Do not mint a general-intelligence scalar; normalized efficiency may be added only after exact baseline/calibration identity exists.
architecture_delta.reliability_requirement: If repeated trials are admitted, report reliability separately from first-contact performance rather than averaging catastrophic failures away.

score_consistency_gate: Any score used by WP807 acceptance must be recomputable from a bound raw-result/evaluator artifact or explicitly delegated to a previously accepted producer contract whose derivation identity is bound. A supported verdict must not be possible solely from arbitrary high submitted score_ppm with zero completion evidence.
wp806_link: WP806 lesion/sham/rescue evidence remains a causal subsystem test. Once integrated episodes exist, reuse matched sealed-family trajectories to test whether lesions change end-to-end completion/recovery/efficiency; do not treat WP806 alone as integrated-agency proof.

counterhypotheses.statement: Four independently strong capability benchmarks are sufficient evidence for a general agentic core.
counterhypotheses.reason: Component competence does not prove composition, shared state continuity, same-agent identity, recovery coupling or end-to-end completion on one unseen task.

counterhypotheses.statement: A single end-to-end completion score is sufficient and component diagnostics can be removed.
counterhypotheses.reason: A scalar can hide brute-force search, memorization, subsystem bypass and brittle recovery; component diagnostics remain necessary.

counterhypotheses.statement: Matching holdout_set_id strings prove shared held-out evidence.
counterhypotheses.reason: Identifier equality is metadata agreement, not cryptographic or causal binding to consumed hidden fixture/family identity.

cheap_high_information_falsifiers: Feed current WP807 four individually accepted CapabilityEvidence records with threshold-passing score_ppm but success_count=0; if supported, require explicit completion/score-consistency repair.
Feed four accepted records with identical holdout_set_id but intentionally different fixture/family commitments; current schema should be classified unable to reject the mismatch.
Feed four accepted records attributed to different agent_build/policy generations; current schema should be classified unable to reject cross-agent composition.
After integrated evidence exists, compare matched baseline / capability-lesion / sham-lesion / rescue trajectories on sealed family members.

nonduplicate_boundary.this_delta: owns same-agent same-episode integrated causal composition and completion identity across WP802-WP806

handoff.action: Preserve the four-capability diagnostic aggregator. Before integrated/general agentic-core support is claimed, add the minimal integrated-episode boundary plus fail-closed tests for cross-agent composition, same-name/different-fixture spoofing, zero-success/high-score inconsistency, missing completion evidence and missing first-contact provenance. Do not import ARC/WebArena/tau-bench frameworks or mint their benchmark scores.
